<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

# Green at cols 24-27, beam at cols 16-22. Red/Blue already at cols 42-45.
# Goal: push green to cols 42-45. Need ~18 cols of push = 3 RIGHTs (6 each).
# Execute 3 RIGHTs and check green position after each
for i in range(3):
    res = action(['RIGHT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    for n in seg:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b = n['boundary']
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            print(f"After RIGHT {i+1}: green cols {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}, rows {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, reward={res.get('reward')}")
    if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('game_over'):
        print("STOP:", res)
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
